name: Central Event Catalogue
description: Aggregated catalogue of all domain events across all modelled journeys. Events are the mechanism for cross-service state propagation via SVC-102 (event bus). Each event entry specifies: owning service, source entity, trigger condition, journey phase, payload schema, consuming services, ordering guarantees, topic, data classification, WORM audit pipeline flag, and source journey tracking. As additional journeys are modelled, new events are appended and the source_journeys array on existing events is extended where they are reused or referenced.
catalogue_principles: Every event name is in past tense (domain event naming convention): the event records a fact that has occurred.
Payload schemas carry the minimum data required for consumers to act. Raw PII fields (document images, biometric scores, full PAN) are never included in event payloads.
All events tagged data_classification: pii or data_classification: financial are routed to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111) in addition to their primary consumers.
Ordering guarantees apply at the event bus (SVC-102) level. The partition key determines per-key ordering — all events for a given customer_id are strictly ordered within a topic partition.
source_journeys tracks which modelled journeys contributed or reference this event — used for impact analysis when evolving event schemas.

events.name: ApplicationStarted
events.trigger: PER-001 submits the account application form via web portal (CH-001) or mobile app (CH-002). SVC-017 calls SVC-001 to create a Customer (prospect) and ApplicationRecord with status = in_progress. ApplicationRecord.application_id is assigned and ApplicationStarted is published.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (Retail Banking / SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory / SVC-050) and CAP-007 (Digital Channels / SVC-017). Crosses CAP-001 → CAP-005 and CAP-001 → CAP-007 boundaries.

payload_schema.application_id: string (UUID v4) — provisional application reference; immutable after publication
payload_schema.customer_id: string (UUID v4) — prospect customer record identifier

consumers.action: Initialises the application flow UI; displays the provisional application reference to PER-001
Initialises the identity verification workflow for the customer; prepares document capture session with the identity verification vendor (Onfido/Jumio)
Creates immutable audit log entry recording the application initiation event with application_id, customer_id, channel, and timestamp

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.applications. All JRN-001 events for a given customer_id are sequenced within the same partition.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id (PII). Consumer Duty evidence: application initiation is part of the regulated application audit trail. Retained in SVC-111 for 7 years (FCA BCOBS / GOV-001-R01).

events.name: IdentityVerificationCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-050 receives the terminal verification result from the identity verification vendor (Onfido/Jumio). Document authenticity check, biometric liveness check, and address verification are all assessed. SVC-050 persists the outcome in the IdentityVerification entity and publishes this event with the outcome (pass | refer | fail | fraud_detected).
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory / SVC-050); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001), CAP-007 (SVC-017), and additional compliance services (SVC-014, SVC-103, SVC-111). Crosses CAP-005 → CAP-001 and CAP-005 → CAP-007 boundaries.
events.payload_omissions: Payload must not include raw document images, document_number, biometric_match_score, or address detail. Raw data is retained within SVC-050 encrypted storage under MLR 2017 Regulation 40 five-year retention. Outcome only.

consumers.action: Consumes verified identity data to initiate PEP, sanctions, and adverse media screening in PH-003
Records identity verification outcome against the ApplicationRecord; outcome = fraud_detected causes ApplicationRecord to transition to suspended status

Advances the application wizard from the PH-002 capture screen: outcome = pass advances to PH-003 holding screen; outcome = fail displays retry/branch referral message; outcome = fraud_detected triggers EX-003 exception path
Creates immutable audit log entry; CDD evidence record required for FCA/NCA records production within 2 business days
Archives event to WORM store; MLR 2017 Regulation 40 five-year CDD retention obligation

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.identity. Only one active IdentityVerification per application_id.
events.worm_rationale: CDD record under MLR 2017 Regulation 40 (five-year retention). Contains customer_id and identity verification outcome.
events.retention: 5 years minimum (MLR 2017 Regulation 40); 7 years where outcome = fraud_detected (FCA fraud record obligation)

events.name: SanctionsScreeningCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-014 calls SVC-051 (Sanctions Screening Service) synchronously during PH-003. SVC-051 returns a sanctions screening result (clear | hit | pending_review). SVC-014 persists the result in KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result and publishes this event. If the result is hit, SanctionsHitDetected (EVT-006) is published immediately after.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by SVC-014 (CAP-005); consumed primarily within CAP-005 (SVC-051 audit, SVC-103). SVC-001 consumes it cross-capability to gate account provisioning.

payload_schema.match_confidence: number (0.0–1.0) — present only when screening_result = hit or pending_review; omitted when clear

events.payload_omissions: List-specific match detail and matched entity names must not appear in the event payload. Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A): payload must not be surfaced to PER-001.

consumers.action: Internal consumption: updates KycAssessment.sanctions_screening_result; determines whether to proceed with full CDD risk scoring or to escalate via SanctionsHitDetected
Creates immutable audit log entry; OFSI requires a complete audit log of all sanctions screening decisions, including CLEAR results
Archives event to WORM store; five-year OFSI audit retention obligation (GOV-005-R02)

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. Strictly follows IdentityVerificationCompleted (EVT-002) in the partition.
events.worm_rationale: OFSI requires audit log of all sanctions screening decisions for five years (GOV-005-R02).

events.name: KYCClearanceGranted
events.trigger: KycAssessment is completed with: pep_screening_result.status = clear, sanctions_screening_result.status = clear, adverse_media_result.severity = low or none, and risk_category = standard or simplified. For the AP-001 alternative path (PEP/EDD referral), this event is published only after MLRO (PER-052) sign-off is recorded.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory / SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) as the gating signal that unlocks account provisioning. This is the primary cross-capability compliance gate event for JRN-001.

payload_schema.next_review_date: string (ISO 8601 UTC date) — perpetual KYC review date based on risk_category

consumers.action: Receives the gating signal that allows account provisioning to proceed. Transitions ApplicationRecord.current_phase to PH-005. No Account record may be created by SVC-001 without first receiving this event (MLR 2017 Regulation 27 technical enforcement).
Marks the KYC/CDD step of the onboarding workflow as complete; closes the identity verification orchestration session
Advances the application wizard UI from the PH-003 KYC holding screen to the PH-004 account decision result screen
Creates immutable audit log entry; CDD clearance record required for FCA supervision evidence
Archives event; MLR 2017 Regulation 40 CDD clearance record retention

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. Published after SanctionsScreeningCompleted (EVT-003). Mutually exclusive with KYCReferralRaised (EVT-005) and SanctionsHitDetected (EVT-006) for a given assessment_id.
events.worm_rationale: CDD clearance record under MLR 2017 Regulation 40. The event is the gating signal for account opening — it must be retained as evidence that CDD was completed before the business relationship was established.
events.retention: 5 years minimum (MLR 2017 Regulation 40); 7 years where account subsequently opened (FCA BCOBS)

events.name: KYCReferralRaised
events.trigger: KycAssessment returns any of: risk_category = enhanced (high-risk score), pep_screening_result.status = match (PEP identified), or adverse_media_result.severity = high. The automated CDD assessment cannot grant clearance. A referral is raised for manual Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) review via the AP-001 alternative path.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to suspend account provisioning, and by CAP-007 (SVC-017) to display the referral status message to PER-001.

payload_schema.referral_reason: string enum (pep_identified | high_risk_score | adverse_media | edd_required | combined)

events.payload_omissions: Specific PEP database match detail, adverse media article references, or risk scoring factors must not appear in the payload. Tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A) applies.

consumers.action: Transitions ApplicationRecord.status to referred and current_phase to AP-001; suspends account provisioning pending EDD completion
Displays the additional review required message to PER-001 with the three-business-day SLA and case reference; triggers SVC-053 to dispatch the referral notification email
Dispatches EDD referral email to PER-001 (without disclosing PEP or SAR detail) and internal alert to compliance case management queue for PER-052 (MLRO) review
Creates immutable audit log entry; CDD referral record required for MLR 2017 Regulation 33 EDD evidence trail

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. Mutually exclusive with KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) and SanctionsHitDetected (EVT-006) for a given assessment_id.
events.worm_rationale: CDD EDD referral record under MLR 2017 Regulations 33–35. Contains customer_id and referral reason — evidence that enhanced due diligence was correctly triggered.

events.name: SanctionsHitDetected
events.trigger: KycAssessment receives a blocked result from SVC-051 (sanctions_screening_result.status = blocked), indicating the customer matches a designated person on the OFSI Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, or EU sanctions lists. Account opening is immediately and irrevocably blocked. MLRO escalation (EX-002 exception path) is triggered.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to block account creation, CAP-007 (SVC-017) for customer-facing generic decline, and compliance workflow services.

payload_schema.list_name: string — name of the sanctions list on which the match was found (e.g. OFSI, OFAC_SDN, UN, EU)

events.payload_omissions: Matched entity name, designation reference, or full match detail must not appear in the event payload. Under no circumstances may this payload be surfaced to PER-001 (tipping-off prohibition, POCA 2002 s333A).

consumers.action: Immediately blocks account provisioning; transitions ApplicationRecord.status to blocked; if any funds were received, triggers account freeze obligation
Displays a generic decline message to PER-001 without disclosing the sanctions match reason (tipping-off prohibition); triggers standard decline email via SVC-053
Dispatches internal MLRO escalation alert to PER-052 (MLRO) via secure internal channel; dispatches generic decline communication to PER-001
Creates immutable audit log entry; OFSI audit trail initiation — this log record is the start of the 14-day OFSI notification clock evidence
Archives event immediately to WORM store; OFSI may request production of this record during regulatory inspection

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. Mutually exclusive with KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) and KYCReferralRaised (EVT-005) for a given assessment_id.
events.data_classification_note: Elevated beyond standard restricted classification. Access restricted to MLRO-governance boundary services and authorised personnel (PER-052). Must not appear in general operations dashboards.
events.worm_rationale: OFSI compliance obligation: all sanctions hit records must be retained and producible on demand. The 14-day OFSI notification clock makes prompt and immutable archival essential.
events.retention: 10 years (OFSI enforcement evidence; exceeds standard MLR 2017 five-year minimum)

events.name: ApplicationDecisionMade
events.trigger: The automated account decision engine in SVC-001 evaluates the combined outputs of identity verification (IdentityVerificationCompleted), KYC/CDD (KYCClearanceGranted or KYCReferralRaised), and eligibility checks. An Approve, Refer, or Decline decision is produced and persisted in ApplicationRecord.decision_outcome. The event is published regardless of outcome, with the decision_basis_ref linking to the evidence record.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-050, SVC-111), CAP-007 (SVC-017), and compliance services.

payload_schema.decision_basis_ref: string (UUID v4) — internal reference to the decision audit record in SVC-001
payload_schema.decline_reason: string enum (kyc_failure | sanctions_hit | identity_fraud | policy_exclusion | eligibility_failure) — present only when decision_outcome = declined; omitted if approved or referred
payload_schema.referral_reason: string enum (high_risk_score | pep_edd_pending | manual_review_required) — present only when decision_outcome = referred; omitted otherwise

events.payload_omissions: Full decision scoring model outputs, specific CDD data inputs, or SAR consideration status must not appear in the payload.

consumers.action: Renders the decision result screen: approval confirmation message, referral status with three-business-day SLA, or decline notification with FOS signpost (Consumer Duty requirement)
Closes or archives the onboarding case; for declined applications, archives the identity verification record per MLR 2017 Regulation 40 retention obligations
Creates immutable audit log entry; the decision audit trail must be retained for minimum five years for FCA supervision evidence (Consumer Duty, AI/ML model validation)
Archives event; Consumer Duty evidence that the decision was communicated; AI/ML model decision audit

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.applications. Published after KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) or KYCReferralRaised (EVT-005) in the partition.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id and decision outcome — PII. Consumer Duty evidence of fair treatment; AI/ML decision audit trail.

events.name: AccountOpened
events.trigger: SVC-001 creates the Account record in PH-005 following receipt of KYCClearanceGranted (EVT-004) and ApplicationDecisionMade with outcome = approved. The Account is created with status = pending (sort code and account number assigned but not yet fully active). This is the primary domain event of JRN-001.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-050, SVC-111) for compliance record finalisation and CAP-007 (SVC-017) for the customer-facing account confirmation screen.

payload_schema.sort_code: string (6-digit UK sort code, format: NN-NN-NN)
payload_schema.iban: string (GB IBAN, format: GBkk BBBB SSSS SSCC CCCC CC)
payload_schema.fscs_eligible: boolean — FSCS depositor protection eligibility flag
payload_schema.account_status: string enum (pending | active) — pending at AccountOpened; active at AccountProvisioned

consumers.action: Advances the application wizard UI to the account details confirmation screen in PH-005; displays sort code and account number to PER-001
Marks the onboarding journey as complete; closes the onboarding case with the account_id as the confirmed outcome reference
Triggers the account opening confirmation push notification to the mobile app
Creates immutable audit log entry; account opening record required for FCA BCOBS seven-year retention
Archives event; FSCS evidence record; PRA Depositor Protection compliance

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.accounts. Published after ApplicationDecisionMade (EVT-007) with outcome = approved. AccountOpened must precede AccountProvisioned (EVT-009) for the same account_id.
events.worm_rationale: Primary financial domain event. Contains account_id, customer_id, sort code, account number, and FSCS flag — financial and PII data.

events.name: AccountProvisioned
events.trigger: Account record transitions from status = pending to status = active in SVC-001 after: (1) FSCS SCV record is created or updated, (2) CASS registration is initiated with Pay.UK, (3) opening balance is confirmed at zero, and (4) account attributes are fully configured. This event signals that the account is operationally live and ready for customer access.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-007 (SVC-017) to advance to digital channel activation (PH-006), and compliance services for FSCS/CASS evidence.

payload_schema.cass_registered: boolean — true when CASS registration with Pay.UK has been initiated

consumers.action: Confirms sort code and account number are live; advances the application wizard to the PH-006 digital channel activation setup screen
Dispatches account active confirmation notification; triggers card delivery tracking notification
Creates immutable audit log entry; account provisioning record including CASS registration flag
Archives event; CASS participation evidence; FSCS SCV confirmation record

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.accounts. Strictly follows AccountOpened (EVT-008) for the same account_id. CardIssuanceTriggered (EVT-010) is published in the same phase but may follow in any order after AccountProvisioned.
events.worm_rationale: Financial event: confirms the account is operationally active. CASS registration evidence. FCA BCOBS and PRA Depositor Protection retention.

events.name: CardIssuanceTriggered
events.trigger: SVC-001 creates the CardIssuance record in PH-005, linking it to the newly provisioned Account. The card processing service (SVC-011 / Marqeta or Thredd) is instructed to initiate physical card production. The event is published to notify downstream services and the customer of the card dispatch workflow.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-007 (SVC-017) for the customer-facing card delivery notification.

payload_schema.estimated_delivery_date: string (ISO 8601 UTC date) — based on card processor SLA
payload_schema.delivery_address_postcode: string (UK postcode only — not full address, for notification purposes)

events.payload_omissions: PAN (Primary Account Number), CVV2, expiry date, and full delivery address must not appear in the event payload. PCI DSS v4.0 compliance: card number is generated and stored exclusively within the card processor (SVC-011) PCI DSS-compliant environment.

consumers.action: Displays the estimated card delivery date on the account summary screen in PH-005 and on the welcome dashboard in PH-007; triggers card dispatch notification via SVC-053
Dispatches card dispatch confirmation notification to PER-001 (push and email) with the estimated delivery date
Creates immutable audit log entry; card issuance record for PCI DSS audit trail

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.cards. Published in PH-005 after AccountProvisioned (EVT-009) in the standard flow.
events.data_classification_note: Delivery address postcode and customer_id included. No cardholder data (PAN/CVV2) in payload — PCI DSS scope is limited to the card processor environment.
events.worm_rationale: PCI DSS v4.0 requires an audit trail for card issuance events. Contains customer_id and card_id — PII.
events.retention: 7 years (PCI DSS v4.0 audit requirement; FCA BCOBS)

events.name: DigitalChannelActivated
events.trigger: DigitalEnrollment.status transitions to active in SVC-017 after the customer completes the following in PH-006: (1) online banking credentials created and stored in SVC-100 (IAM), (2) FIDO2/WebAuthn biometric SCA factor enrolled and device registered with SVC-100, (3) push notification permissions configured, (4) first-login SCA authentication completed successfully. This event signals that the customer has operational digital access to their account.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-007 (Digital Channels / SVC-017); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to confirm the account is accessible, and by compliance services. This event marks the functional completion of the account opening journey.
events.payload_omissions: Biometric template data must not appear in the payload. Under FIDO2/WebAuthn, the biometric template never leaves the device. UK GDPR Article 9 special category data minimisation.

consumers.action: Confirms the account is operationally accessible to the customer; updates any account-level digital access flag
Triggers the welcome pack dispatch workflow in PH-007 (this event is the entry condition for PH-007)
Creates immutable audit log entry; SCA enrolment record required for PSR 2017 Regulation 100 compliance evidence

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.channels. Published after AccountProvisioned (EVT-009). Strictly precedes WelcomePackDispatched (EVT-013).
events.worm_rationale: SCA enrolment record: PSR 2017 Regulation 100 and FCA RTS on SCA compliance evidence. Contains customer_id and channel activation status — PII.

events.name: CustomerRiskScoreUpdated
events.trigger: A perpetual KYC (pKYC) periodic review of an existing customer's KycAssessment results in a changed risk_category or changed risk_score. May be triggered by: (1) scheduled periodic review based on next_review_date, (2) SanctionsListUpdated event from SVC-051 triggering batch portfolio rescreening, (3) adverse media monitoring detecting a new negative news item, or (4) MLRO-initiated manual review. Not phase-specific — occurs throughout the life of the customer relationship post-onboarding.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (Compliance & Regulatory / SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to adjust account-level monitoring thresholds. Not phase-specific to JRN-001 but published by SVC-014 throughout the customer relationship lifecycle established by JRN-001.

payload_schema.assessment_id: string (UUID v4) — updated KycAssessment entity identifier

consumers.action: Adjusts account-level transaction monitoring thresholds to reflect the updated CDD risk tier; for risk_category escalations, may trigger account controls review or temporary transaction limits
Creates immutable audit log entry; pKYC risk score change record required for MLR 2017 ongoing monitoring evidence

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.kyc. No strict ordering dependency with other event types — this event may occur at any time post-onboarding.
events.worm_rationale: Ongoing CDD monitoring record under MLR 2017 Regulation 28 (ongoing monitoring obligation). Risk score changes are compliance-sensitive records.
events.retention: 5 years from the date of update (MLR 2017 Regulation 40)

events.name: WelcomePackDispatched
events.trigger: SVC-017 confirms successful delivery of the welcome communications in PH-007: (1) welcome email (including FSCS information sheet and account details) dispatched via SVC-053, (2) in-app welcome message displayed and acknowledged, (3) FSCS information sheet delivery confirmed. The event is published only when delivery is confirmed — not on dispatch attempt. GOV-001-R02 mandates FSCS information sheet delivery at account opening.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-007 (Digital Channels / SVC-017); consumed by SVC-103 and SVC-111 within the compliance and audit layer. This event marks the terminal state of JRN-001.

payload_schema.channels_used: array<string enum (email | in_app | push)> — delivery channels through which the welcome pack was successfully dispatched
payload_schema.fscs_sheet_delivered: boolean — explicit flag confirming FSCS information sheet delivery (GOV-001-R02 compliance evidence)
payload_schema.vulnerability_screening_completed: boolean — flag confirming PH-007 wellbeing questions were surfaced to PER-001 (FCA FG21/1)

consumers.action: Creates immutable audit log entry; Consumer Duty evidence that all required disclosures (FSCS information sheet, product terms) were communicated at account opening
Archives event for five years; GOV-001-R02 mandatory FSCS information sheet delivery evidence; Consumer Duty disclosure audit record

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.channels. Published after DigitalChannelActivated (EVT-011) for the same customer_id. This is the terminal event of the JRN-001 happy path.
events.worm_rationale: Mandatory Consumer Duty disclosure evidence (GOV-001-R02). The FSCS information sheet delivery confirmation is a regulatory obligation — this event is the proof of delivery.
events.retention: 5 years (Consumer Duty evidence; GOV-001-R02 FSCS disclosure obligation)

events.name: SARInvestigationOpened
events.trigger: SVC-014 creates a SARInvestigationRecord when a suspicion trigger is received — either an automated event (SanctionsHitDetected EVT-006, FraudScoreCompleted) or a manual staff disclosure submitted via SVC-015. Published immediately on record creation.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and consumed within CAP-005. SVC-103 and SVC-111 receive it for audit/WORM pipeline purposes.

consumers.action: Triggers MLRO case management alert. Adds investigation to MLRO dashboard.
Creates immutable audit log entry for investigation opening.
Routes event to 7-year WORM retention store.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-investigations.
events.worm_rationale: SAR investigation records must be retained for 7 years WORM (MLR 2017 Regulation 40).

events.name: SARDecisionMade
events.trigger: MLRO records their formal decision (file_sar, file_defensive_sar, or dismissed) via SVC-015 case management. Published immediately on decision record creation. Starts the 5-business-day SLA clock where decision = file or file_defensive.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Decision event consumed only within CAP-005 and shared infrastructure (SVC-103, SVC-111).

payload_schema.sar_id: string (UUID v4) — null if decision = dismissed
payload_schema.sla_deadline: string (ISO 8601 date — 5 business days from decision_date, null if dismissed)

consumers.action: Updates MLRO dashboard with decision status and SLA countdown.
Creates immutable audit log entry for MLRO decision.
Routes to 7-year WORM retention.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-investigations.
events.worm_rationale: MLRO decision is a legally significant act under POCA 2002. Decision timestamp is evidence of SLA compliance.

events.name: SARFiled
events.trigger: SVC-014 receives NCA SAR Online acknowledgement with NCA reference number. Published immediately on acknowledgement receipt. This is the primary cross-capability event — consumed by SVC-001 for account restriction coordination.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for account restriction. Crosses CAP-005 → CAP-001 boundary.

payload_schema.sar_id: string (UUID v4) — internal SAR reference only
payload_schema.restriction_required: boolean — true if MLRO has determined account restrictions are needed

events.payload_design_note: NCA reference, grounds of suspicion, typology codes, and SAR narrative are DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED. Payload contains only the minimum required for SVC-001 to act on the restriction signal. Enforces POCA 2002 s333A tipping-off prohibition at the architecture level.

consumers.action: Reads restriction_required flag. If true, applies enhanced_monitoring_flag to customer accounts. Does NOT receive SAR detail. Account notices to customer use pre-approved generic language only.
Creates immutable audit log of SAR filing event.
Routes to 7-year WORM retention.

explicit_consumer_restrictions: SVC-017 (Digital Channels): MUST NOT consume — explicit deny at event bus subscription level
Any customer-facing service: MUST NOT consume
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-filings.
events.worm_rationale: SAR filing event is the definitive record of the bank's NCA disclosure. Timestamp is evidence of 5-business-day SLA compliance.

events.name: SARConsentRequested
events.trigger: Published when a consent SAR is filed — MLRO has filed seeking NCA permission before processing a specific transaction (POCA 2002 s338 consent regime). Published simultaneously with SARFiled (EVT-016) when consent_requested = true.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to place the specific transaction on hold.

payload_schema.consent_transaction_ref: string — internal transaction ID for which NCA consent is sought

consumers.action: Places transaction consent_transaction_ref on hold. Fail-closed: hold persists until SARConsentGranted (EVT-018) received.
Creates immutable audit log of consent moratorium start.
Routes to WORM retention.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-filings.

events.name: SARConsentGranted
events.trigger: Published when NCA grants consent for the transaction in a consent SAR, or when the 7-day moratorium expires without NCA refusal (deemed consent). MLRO records the consent grant via POST /sars/{id}/consent-response. NOT published when NCA refuses consent.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-014); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) to release the transaction hold.

payload_schema.consent_transaction_ref: string — transaction for which consent was granted
payload_schema.nca_response_reference: string (null if moratorium_expired with no NCA response)

events.not_published_when: NCA refuses consent. Transaction hold remains permanently until MLRO manually resolves.

consumers.action: Releases transaction hold for consent_transaction_ref. ONLY this event may release the hold.
Creates immutable audit log of consent resolution.
Routes to WORM retention.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic compliance.sar-filings.

events.name: AccountRestrictionApplied
events.trigger: SVC-001 applies enhanced monitoring or account restriction to a customer's accounts on receipt of SARFiled (EVT-016) with restriction_required = true. Published to confirm restriction application.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001). Consumed by SVC-103 and SVC-111 for audit/WORM purposes only.

payload_schema.account_ids: array<string (UUID v4)> — accounts to which restriction was applied
payload_schema.trigger_sar_id: string (UUID v4) — internal reference only, NOT surfaced to customer or customer-facing APIs

consumers.action: Creates immutable audit log of account restriction. Links to SAR via trigger_sar_id.
Routes to WORM retention for annual MLRO report data aggregation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.accounts.
events.worm_rationale: Account restriction applied as SAR consequence must be retained as part of the 7-year SAR audit trail.

events.name: PaymentIntentCreated
events.trigger: PER-001 has completed SCA and the channel has called POST /payments. SVC-001 has validated account status (active), available balance, and daily payment limit. PaymentIntent is created with status = pending_screening.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-051), CAP-004 (SVC-013), and SVC-103. Initiates concurrent cross-capability pre-execution checks.

payload_schema.cop_result: string enum (match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist)

consumers.action: Runs real-time OFSI/UN/EU/OFAC sanctions screen on payee. Publishes SanctionsScreeningCompleted (EVT-180).
Runs ML fraud scoring. Publishes FraudScoreCompleted (EVT-181).
Creates immutable audit log entry for payment initiation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic retail.payments.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id (PII) and payment amount (financial). Required for APP fraud reimbursement audit trail (GOV-003-R01) and OFSI screening log (GOV-005-R02). Retained 5 years minimum.

events.name: SanctionsScreeningCompleted
events.source_entity_name: Stateless — no owning entity in SVC-051
events.trigger: SVC-051 completes a real-time sanctions screen triggered by PaymentIntentCreated (EVT-179). Screens against OFSI, UN, EU, and US OFAC lists.
events.jrn001_schema_note: Schema pattern reuses the SanctionsScreeningCompleted concept from JRN-001 (EVT-003 in the KYC flow). This instance (EVT-180) is published by SVC-051 directly as an async event (JRN-001 used a synchronous call pattern).

consumers.action: Evaluates outcome. Clear + EVT-181 non-block: publish PaymentCleared. Hit: publish PaymentFailed (sanctions_review), alert MLRO.
Immutably logs all screening results (including cleared hits) per OFSI GOV-005-R02 obligation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic compliance.screening.
events.worm_rationale: OFSI requires audit log of all sanctions screening decisions including cleared hits (GOV-005-R02). 5 years minimum retention.

events.name: FraudScoreCompleted
events.source_entity_name: Stateless — no owning entity in SVC-013 for this journey
events.trigger: SVC-013 completes ML fraud scoring triggered by consuming PaymentIntentCreated (EVT-179). Must complete within 500ms P99.

consumers.action: Evaluates risk_level. Block: publish PaymentFraudBlocked. Non-block + EVT-180 clear: publish PaymentCleared.
Receives redacted version (risk_level retained, raw fraud_score omitted).

events.access_control_note: fraud_score raw value must not be surfaced to PER-001 or included in SVC-103 general audit log.
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id on topic fraud.scores.
events.worm_rationale: Fraud scoring decisions are part of APP fraud reimbursement audit trail (GOV-003-R01). risk_level (not raw score) retained in WORM pipeline.

events.name: PaymentCleared
events.trigger: SVC-001 received both SanctionsScreeningCompleted (clear) and FraudScoreCompleted (non-block). All pre-execution checks passed. PaymentIntent.status = processing.

consumers.action: Constructs ISO 20022 pacs.008 and submits to Vocalink FPS. Creates PaymentExecution (ENT-009). Publishes PaymentExecuted on acceptance.
Records payment cleared decision.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id on topic retail.payments.
events.worm_rationale: Records the bank authorisation point for payment execution. Required for APP fraud reimbursement audit trail.

events.name: PaymentExecuted
events.trigger: SVC-009 received Vocalink FPS acceptance (pacs.002 ACCP). PaymentExecution entity created with settlement_status = accepted.

consumers.action: Debits account ledger. Updates PaymentIntent.status = completed. Updates Account.daily_payment_total. Publishes AccountDebited.
Writes confirmed execution to OFSI audit log (GOV-005-R02).
Records FPS execution with fps_reference in WORM audit pipeline.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id on topic payments.execution.
events.worm_rationale: fps_reference is primary audit evidence for APP fraud claims and OFSI payment tracing.

events.name: AccountDebited
events.trigger: SVC-001 consumed PaymentExecuted and atomically debited the account ledger. PaymentIntent.status = completed. Account.daily_payment_total updated.

consumers.action: Ingests debit for ongoing AML transaction monitoring (GOV-005-R01). May trigger SAR referral.
Signals payment complete. Channel renders confirmation screen. Triggers SVC-053 push notification and email.
Records account debit in WORM pipeline.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id on topic retail.accounts.
events.worm_rationale: Account debit is a financial transaction subject to FCA BCOBS records retention (7 years) and AML monitoring obligations.

events.name: PaymentFailed
events.trigger: Payment cannot proceed due to: (a) insufficient funds, (b) daily limit exceeded, (c) sanctions hit, (d) FPS rejection/timeout after retries, or (e) sanctions screening service timeout.

payload_schema.failure_reason: string enum (insufficient_funds | daily_limit_exceeded | fps_rejection | fps_timeout | sanctions_review | sanctions_timeout_hold)
payload_schema.customer_facing_message_key: string — i18n key for approved customer message

consumers.action: Renders approved failure message from customer_facing_message_key. Never exposes failure_reason = sanctions_review to customer (tipping-off prohibition).
Records full failure_reason (including sanctions detail) in WORM audit log.

events.tipping_off_control: failure_reason = sanctions_review must never be surfaced to PER-001. customer_facing_message_key maps to generic decline.
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id on topic retail.payments.

events.name: PaymentFraudBlocked
events.trigger: SVC-001 consumed FraudScoreCompleted with risk_level = block. PaymentIntent.status = fraud_blocked. Fraud Analyst case created.

payload_schema.top_risk_features: array<string> — for Fraud Analyst case review

consumers.action: Creates fraud investigation case in INTL-003. Assigns to PER-054 (Fraud Analyst).
Renders generic fraud block message: no fraud score or risk level disclosed to customer.
Records block event in WORM pipeline (risk_level recorded; raw fraud_score not included).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id on topic fraud.blocks.
events.worm_rationale: Fraud block decisions are part of APP fraud reimbursement claims audit trail (GOV-003-R01). Required for gross negligence defence assessment.

topic_summary.description: All events are published via SVC-102 (Event Bus). Topics are logical partitioning boundaries; all topics use customer_id as the default partition key.

topics.note: EVT-019 added to retail.accounts topic by JRN-003. Published by SVC-001 on SAR-triggered account restriction.

topics.access_restriction: auditor_only — explicit subscription deny rules for all non-authorised consumers
auditor_only for investigation events; SVC-001 authorised to consume EVT-016/017/018 with minimal payload only. SVC-017 explicitly denied.

worm_audit_pipeline_summary.description: All events in this catalogue are routed to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111). SAR events (EVT-014 through EVT-019) added by JRN-003 are classified auditor_only with 7-year WORM retention.

retention_tiers.regulatory_basis: FCA BCOBS; Consumer Duty; PRA Depositor Protection
MLR 2017 Regulation 40 (SAR records — bank policy extends statutory 5-year minimum); POCA 2002 criminal liability evidence
MLR 2017 Regulation 40 — business customer CDD record-keeping obligation

jrn004_events.note: JRN-004 (Business Current Account Opening) introduces 9 new domain events. These are fully catalogued in /artefacts/models/business-current-account-opening/events/event-catalogue.json. A summary registry is provided here for cross-journey reference.

jrn005_events.note: JRN-005 (APP Fraud Detection and Reimbursement) introduces 9 new domain events. Full event specifications are catalogued in /artefacts/models/app-fraud-detection-reimbursement/events/event-catalogue.json. A summary registry is provided here for cross-journey reference. Three event topics are introduced: fraud.cases, fraud.decisions, fraud.reimbursements, fraud.recovery, and fraud.patterns.

event_registry.name: FraudCaseCreated
event_registry.summary: Published when SVC-013 creates a FraudCase — either from customer fraud report or PaymentFraudBlocked (EVT-186) consumption. Starts the 5-business-day PSR SLA clock.

event_registry.name: FraudInvestigationStarted
event_registry.summary: Published when FraudCase.status transitions to investigating (analyst assigned within 4 hours of FraudCaseCreated).

event_registry.name: FraudReimbursementApproved
event_registry.summary: Published when decision=approve or partial. Primary cross-capability event: consumed by SVC-001 (account credit) and SVC-009 (ReimbursementClaim creation). Contains reimbursement_amount (max £85,000) and receiving_sort_code.

event_registry.name: FraudReimbursementDeclined
event_registry.summary: Published when decision=decline. Requires Senior Manager co-sign. Triggers regulated outcome letter with FOS signpost. gross_negligence_evidence NOT in event payload — stored encrypted in FraudCase entity only.

event_registry.name: ReimbursementCredited
event_registry.summary: Published by SVC-001 after credit applied to customer Account. Contains sla_business_days_elapsed — primary PSR 5-day SLA compliance evidence. P99 < 30 minutes from FraudReimbursementApproved consumption.

event_registry.name: RecoveryInitiated
event_registry.summary: Published by SVC-009 after ReimbursementClaim created and Pay.UK recovery claim submitted. Contains pay_uk_claim_reference and receiving_bank_share (50% of reimbursement_amount).

event_registry.name: RecoveryCompleted
event_registry.summary: Published when ReimbursementClaim reaches terminal recovery_status (full | partial | failed). Contains net_bank_cost after recovery. Recovery timeline is independent of the 5-day customer reimbursement SLA.

event_registry.name: FraudCaseClosed
event_registry.summary: Published when FraudCase.status = closed. Triggers SVC-111 WORM archive job (7-year retention from closed_at). Contains sla_met flag for PSR quarterly reporting. Final event in FraudCase event stream.

event_registry.name: FraudPatternDetected
event_registry.summary: Published at case closure for every FraudCase. Contains anonymised pattern features (PII-free by design) fed back to SVC-013 ML model training pipeline. Closes the detect-investigate feedback loop. Retained 5 years for model governance under PRA SS1/23.

event_topics_introduced.description: FraudCase lifecycle events: FraudCaseCreated, FraudInvestigationStarted, FraudCaseClosed

jrn006_events.note: JRN-006 (Residential Mortgage Application) introduces 11 new domain events (EVT-020 through EVT-030). Full event specifications are catalogued in /artefacts/models/residential-mortgage-application/events/event-catalogue.json. Two event topics are introduced: retail.mortgages (mortgage lifecycle events) and retail.mortgage-risk (cross-capability credit check events to/from SVC-012).

event_registry.name: MortgageEnquiryStarted
event_registry.summary: Published when customer initiates a mortgage enquiry (PH-009). Consumed by SVC-014 to check existing KYC status. Cross-capability: CAP-001 → CAP-005.

event_registry.name: DIPIssued
event_registry.summary: Published when DIP is issued after soft credit check passes and affordability assessment passes (PH-010). Valid 90 days. Consumed by SVC-053 for DIP certificate dispatch.

event_registry.name: CreditCheckRequested
event_registry.summary: Published by SVC-002 to request a credit check from SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004). check_type: soft (DIP, no bureau footprint) or hard (full application, footprint recorded). Cross-capability: CAP-001 → CAP-004. Also consumed by SVC-014 on full_application to trigger AML property check.

event_registry.name: CreditCheckCompleted
event_registry.summary: Published by SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004) in response to EVT-022. Contains credit score, outcome (pass|refer|fail), and report reference. Consumed by SVC-002 to progress DIP or full application. Cross-capability: CAP-004 → CAP-001.

event_registry.name: ValuationInstructed
event_registry.summary: Published when SVC-002 instructs a property valuation (PH-012). Consumed by SVC-053 to notify customer. Valuation type: desktop (AVM) | drive_by | full.

event_registry.name: ValuationCompleted
event_registry.summary: Published when valuation report is received. Contains valuation_amount, down_valuation_flag, and recalculated LTV. down_valuation_flag = true triggers EX-001 exception path and down-valuation notification to customer.

event_registry.name: MortgageUnderwritingCompleted
event_registry.summary: Published when PER-055 (Mortgage Underwriter) submits underwriting decision (PH-013). Decision: approved | referred | declined. Core MCOB-regulated lending decision — 7-year WORM retention mandatory.

event_registry.name: MortgageOfferIssued
event_registry.summary: Published when mortgage offer (ENT-015) is created (PH-014). Consumed by SVC-053 to dispatch offer document to customer and solicitor. Contains reflection_period_end (offer_date + 7 days, MCOB 6.7) and expiry_date (offer_date + 6 months).

event_registry.name: MortgageOfferAccepted
event_registry.summary: Published when customer formally accepts mortgage offer (PH-014). Validated: accepted_date >= offer_date + 7 days (MCOB 6.7 reflection period). Signals application is ready for completion queue.

event_registry.name: MortgageCompleted
event_registry.summary: Published when CHAPS funds are confirmed released to solicitor on completion day (PH-015). Contains chaps_payment_reference. Consumed by SVC-001 (Customer product holdings) and SVC-014 (AML post-completion monitoring). Cross-capability: CAP-001 → CAP-001 (SVC-001) and CAP-001 → CAP-005 (SVC-014).

event_registry.name: MortgageAccountOpened
event_registry.summary: Published when ENT-016 MortgageAccount is created at completion (PH-015). Final event in JRN-006 happy path. Consumed by SVC-001 (Single Customer View update) and SVC-053 (mortgage welcome pack dispatch). Contains outstanding_balance, monthly_payment, rate, term_remaining_months, opened_date.

event_topics_introduced.partition_key: customer_id (for customer-journey events) / application_id (for application-lifecycle events)
event_topics_introduced.description: All mortgage application lifecycle events: MortgageEnquiryStarted, DIPIssued, ValuationInstructed, ValuationCompleted, MortgageUnderwritingCompleted, MortgageOfferIssued, MortgageOfferAccepted, MortgageCompleted, MortgageAccountOpened

Cross-capability credit check events between SVC-002 (CAP-001) and SVC-012 (CAP-004): CreditCheckRequested, CreditCheckCompleted. Separate topic to isolate CAP-004 event consumption and enable independent scaling.

jrn007_events.description: Events introduced by JRN-007. EVT-031 through EVT-039. Spans CAP-002 (SVC-005 Commercial Banking Core) and CAP-004 (SVC-012 Risk Engine). EVT-032 (CreditAssessmentRequested) and EVT-033 (CreditAssessmentCompleted) are the cross-capability async boundary events between CAP-002 and CAP-004 — no synchronous calls cross this boundary.

events.name: LoanApplicationSubmitted
events.summary: Published when SVC-005 creates ENT-017 (LoanApplication) with status=submitted. Triggers application acknowledgement notification. Immediately followed by EVT-032 (CreditAssessmentRequested) from SVC-005.

events.name: CreditAssessmentRequested
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-005); consumed by CAP-004 (SVC-012). The ONLY permitted cross-capability communication mechanism between SVC-005 and SVC-012. No synchronous API permitted.
events.summary: Cross-capability event requesting automated IRB credit scoring from SVC-012. Payload includes application_id, business_customer_id, requested_amount, term_months, security_type. SVC-012 responds via EVT-033.

events.name: CreditAssessmentCompleted
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-012); consumed by CAP-002 (SVC-005). Return leg of the async credit assessment exchange. Carries assessment_id, risk_rating, pd_score, lgd_estimate, ead, ecl_provision, ifrs9_stage, scoring_model_version.
events.summary: Automated IRB scoring results from SVC-012. risk_rating >= 8 triggers mandatory credit committee referral in SVC-005. Contains assessment_id (FK to ENT-018 in SVC-012) which SVC-005 stores as a cross-capability reference.

events.name: LoanApproved
events.summary: Published when credit committee (or RM within authority) approves the loan. Triggers FacilityAgreement creation (PH-020). Includes approved_amount, risk_rating, approved_by (SMCR staff_id).

events.name: LoanDeclined
events.summary: Terminal event — journey ends. Triggers formal decline letter with BBRS signposting (GOV-002-R03) and FCA SME disclosure (GOV-002-R05). No FacilityAgreement or LoanAccount created after this event.

events.name: FacilityAgreed
events.summary: Published when customer executes the facility agreement (ETDA-compliant or wet ink). Gates drawdown — SVC-005 will not process a drawdown instruction without this event. Contains agreement_id, approved_amount, rate, all_conditions_precedent_satisfied.

events.name: LoanDrawnDown
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published after synchronous CHAPS settlement confirmation from SVC-009 (CAP-003). Consumed by SVC-012 (CAP-004) for RWA + IFRS 9 portfolio updates. Cross-capability consumption only — no response event expected.
events.summary: Published after CHAPS settlement of drawdown disbursement to BusinessAccount. Updates LoanAccount.outstanding_balance. Consumed by SVC-012 for Basel 3.1 RWA and IFRS 9 ECL updates.

events.name: LoanAccountOpened
events.capability_scope_rationale: Consumed by SVC-012 (CAP-004) to register the loan in the active portfolio. Also triggers PH-022 monitoring activation in SVC-005.
events.summary: Published immediately after EVT-037 on first drawdown. Confirms LoanAccount is live on commercial ledger. Activates covenant monitoring schedule in SVC-005. Contains account_id, covenant_count, maturity_date.

events.name: CovenantBreachDetected
events.capability_scope_rationale: Consumed by SVC-012 (CAP-004) for IFRS 9 SICR re-assessment and potential stage migration. Also triggers RM escalation workflow within SVC-005.
events.summary: Published when a covenant test produces compliance_status=breached. Transitions LoanAccount.status=watch_list. Triggers IFRS 9 SICR evaluation in SVC-012. Requires RM/committee engagement for waiver or enforcement. BBRS dispute evidence (GOV-002-R03).

event_topics_introduced.description: Loan origination lifecycle events: LoanApplicationSubmitted, CreditAssessmentRequested, LoanApproved, LoanDeclined, FacilityAgreed. Per-application ordering guaranteed via application_id partition key.

Cross-capability credit assessment exchange between SVC-005 (CAP-002) and SVC-012 (CAP-004): CreditAssessmentRequested (EVT-032), CreditAssessmentCompleted (EVT-033). Separate topic isolates CAP-004 event consumption.
Loan account lifecycle events post-drawdown: LoanDrawnDown, LoanAccountOpened. Consumed by SVC-012 for ongoing portfolio capital and IFRS 9 management.
Covenant monitoring and breach events: CovenantBreachDetected. Per-account ordering via loan_account_id partition key.

jrn008_events.name: CreditCardApplicationSubmitted
jrn008_events.trigger: Customer submits a credit card application at PH-023. SVC-003 creates ENT-022 CreditCardApplication with status = 'submitted' and publishes this event. Automated eligibility pre-check passes before publication.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-003). Consumed by SVC-053 (Notification Service, intra-capability) and SVC-103 (Audit). This event does not cross a capability boundary.

payload_schema.product_id: string (UUID v4) — FK to ENT-024 CardProduct
payload_schema.employment_status: string enum (employed_full_time | employed_part_time | self_employed | retired | student | unemployed | other)
payload_schema.requested_limit: number | null — requested credit limit in GBP (null if not specified)

jrn008_events.payload_pii_note: income_declared is NOT included in the payload (PII minimisation). It is held on ENT-022 in SVC-003 persistence only.

consumers.action: Sends application received confirmation to customer. Includes application reference number and expected decision timeline. CCA 1974 s56 adequate explanation has already been provided at application form stage.
Creates immutable audit log entry for credit card application submission. Application_id and timestamp are the primary audit keys.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.credit-cards.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id (PII). CCA 1974 and CONC require credit application records to be retained. Retained for 6 years post account closure.
jrn008_events.retention: 6 years post account closure (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111)

jrn008_events.name: CreditCheckRequested
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-003 has completed automated eligibility checks at PH-024 and is ready to request a hard credit check from SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004). Customer identity data has been retrieved from SVC-001 (same-capability direct call). This event crosses the CAP-001 → CAP-004 boundary and must be async.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-003). Consumed by CAP-004 (SVC-012 Risk Engine). Crosses the CAP-001 / CAP-004 capability boundary — async events only; no synchronous cross-capability calls.

payload_schema.application_id: string (UUID v4) — ENT-022 identifier (partition key for SVC-012)
payload_schema.customer_id: string (UUID v4) — used by SVC-012 to retrieve full Customer data for bureau submission
payload_schema.check_type: string enum: hard — credit card application always uses a hard search (visible footprint on credit file)
payload_schema.income_declared: number — gross annual income GBP (needed by SVC-012 for affordability cross-check against bureau data)

consumers.action: Receives CreditCheckRequested. Retrieves Customer identity data from SVC-001 (SVC-012 may call SVC-001 directly — both within cross-capability read access). Submits hard search to credit bureau (Experian/Equifax/TransUnion). Runs internal credit scoring model. Derives recommended credit limit based on income, score, and credit policy. Publishes EVT-042 CreditCheckCompleted with outcome.
Records credit check request in WORM audit trail. ICO/CRA audit evidence — hard search request is an auditable event.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application strict ordering via application_id partition key. Guaranteed exactly-once delivery to SVC-012 — deduplication key is application_id + check_type.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Hard credit search request. ICO and CRA code of practice require records of bureau queries. CCA s157 requires the bank to be able to disclose which CRA was queried.

jrn008_events.name: CreditCheckCompleted
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-012 has received the credit bureau response and completed its internal scoring model run. Publishes the credit decision, risk band, and recommended credit limit back to SVC-003 via the event bus. This event crosses the CAP-004 → CAP-001 boundary.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-012 Risk Engine). Consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-003 Credit Card Service). Crosses the CAP-004 / CAP-001 boundary — async only.

payload_schema.application_id: string (UUID v4) — correlates to EVT-041 CreditCheckRequested (idempotency key)
payload_schema.credit_risk_band: string enum: A | B | C | D | E — bank's internal risk banding
payload_schema.recommended_credit_limit: number | null — recommended credit limit in GBP; null if outcome = decline
payload_schema.credit_assessment_reference: string (UUID) — SVC-012 internal assessment record ID (for CCA s157 right-to-know)
payload_schema.cra_used: string enum: experian | equifax | transunion — which CRA was queried (for CCA s157 disclosure)

jrn008_events.raw_score_note: Raw credit score is NOT included in the event payload. Credit score is held within SVC-012 and accessible only via credit_assessment_reference. This prevents score leakage into downstream systems not cleared for score data.

consumers.action: Consumes EVT-042. Transitions ENT-022 status from 'submitted' to 'assessment_complete'. Stores credit_assessment_reference and credit_risk_band on ENT-022. Triggers the decisioning workflow (PH-025). Idempotent on application_id + check_type.
Records credit check completion in WORM audit trail.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application strict ordering via application_id partition key. Guaranteed exactly-once delivery to SVC-003.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Credit check outcome is a legally significant event under CCA 1974. Retained for regulatory inspection and SAR requests.

jrn008_events.name: CreditCardApproved
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-003 credit policy decisioning logic runs at PH-025 and determines the application is approved. EVT-042 outcome = 'pass', credit policy rules satisfied, credit limit assigned. ENT-022 status transitions to 'approved'.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-003). Consumed by SVC-003 internal issuance workflow, SVC-053 (notification), and SVC-103 (audit). Does not cross a capability boundary.

payload_schema.assigned_credit_limit: number — approved credit limit in GBP

consumers.action: Internal consumption: triggers PH-026 card issuance workflow. Creates ENT-023 CreditCardAccount. Initiates PAN generation via card processing platform.
Sends credit card approval notification to customer: approved credit limit, assigned APR, next steps for card receipt and activation. Pre-contractual credit information (SECCI) dispatched.
Records approval decision in WORM audit trail with assigned_credit_limit and apr.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Approval decision is the point at which the regulated credit agreement is entered into under CCA 1974. Immutable record required.
jrn008_events.retention: 6 years post account closure (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111)

jrn008_events.name: CreditCardDeclined
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-003 credit policy decisioning logic runs at PH-025 and determines the application is declined. EVT-042 outcome = 'decline', or credit policy rules not satisfied (e.g. income below threshold, employment status policy). ENT-022 status transitions to 'declined'.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-003). Consumed by SVC-053 (notification) and SVC-103 (audit).

payload_schema.decline_reason_code: string enum: credit_score_below_threshold | income_insufficient | policy_exception | existing_indebtedness | automated_decline
payload_schema.cra_used: string | null — name of CRA queried (for CCA s157 right-to-know disclosure in decline notice)
payload_schema.credit_assessment_reference: string | null — reference to SVC-012 assessment (for CCA s157)

consumers.action: Sends decline notification to customer. Must include: reason summary (not full score — CONC 7.3 proportionality), name of CRA used (CCA s157), right to request human review (UK GDPR Art. 22 if automated), signpost to FOS and MoneyHelper (Consumer Duty), reference to Subject Access Right.
Records decline decision in WORM audit trail. Regulatory audit: FCA CONC supervision may require evidence of decisioning rationale.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via customer_id partition key.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Decline decision is a regulated act under CCA 1974 and CONC. Retained for regulatory inspection.

jrn008_events.name: CreditCardIssued
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-003 has completed card issuance at PH-026: ENT-023 CreditCardAccount created, PAN generated and tokenised within the PCI CDE, virtual card available in-app, physical card dispatch ordered. The event payload contains card_number_token ONLY — no raw PAN, no CVV, no expiry outside the secure in-app viewer.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-003). Consumed by SVC-053 (notification of card dispatch) and SVC-103 (audit). Intra-capability.

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — PCI-compliant token from tokenisation vault. NO raw PAN in this field or anywhere in this payload.
payload_schema.virtual_card_available: boolean — true; virtual card immediately usable via secure in-app viewer
payload_schema.physical_card_dispatch_date: string (ISO 8601 date) — date physical card dispatched to registered address

jrn008_events.pci_compliance_note: PCI DSS v4.0 Req 3.3.1 and 3.5: This event payload MUST NOT contain the raw PAN (Primary Account Number), full expiry date in combination with PAN, or CVV/CVC. card_number_token is the only card identifier permitted outside the PCI CDE. Any consumer of this event that attempts to resolve the token to a PAN must itself be within the PCI CDE.

consumers.action: Sends card issuance confirmation to customer: virtual card is available in the app now; physical card expected in 3–5 business days. Includes activation instructions.
Updates customer product holdings record to reflect new credit card account (ENT-023.account_id). Enables cross-sell and SCV completeness.
Records card issuance in WORM audit trail. PCI DSS Req 10.2 — card issuance events must be logged.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: PCI DSS Req 10.2 requires logging of all access to cardholder data and card issuance events. Retained per PCI DSS Req 10.7 (12 months immediately available, 12 months archived).
jrn008_events.retention: 12 months immediately available; 12 months archived (PCI DSS Req 10.7). Also retained 6 years for CCA/CONC compliance (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111).

jrn008_events.name: CreditCardActivated
jrn008_events.trigger: Customer activates their physical credit card at PH-027 via the banking app (explicit SCA-authenticated activation) or via first card transaction (implicit activation triggered by authorisation event from JRN-011). ENT-023 status transitions from 'issued' to 'active'.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-003). Consumed by SVC-053 and SVC-103. Intra-capability.

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — PCI-compliant token; no raw PAN

consumers.action: Sends card activation confirmation: card is now active, credit limit confirmed, first statement date communicated, link to manage card settings.
Records activation event in WORM audit trail.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Card activation is a security-relevant event per PCI DSS Req 10.2.

jrn008_events.name: StatementGenerated
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-003 generates a monthly statement at PH-028 on the account's statement_date. ENT-025 StatementCycle record is created. The event is published after successful creation of the StatementCycle record.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-003). Consumed by SVC-053 (statement notification) and SVC-103 (audit). Intra-capability.

payload_schema.minimum_payment_due: number — minimum payment due in GBP
payload_schema.payment_due_date: string (ISO 8601 date) — at least 25 days after statement_date
payload_schema.persistent_debt_months: integer — snapshot value for this cycle

consumers.action: Sends statement available notification to customer: statement date, closing balance, minimum payment due, payment due date, link to view statement in app/portal. If paper statement selected: triggers physical statement generation.
Records statement generation in WORM audit trail.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key. Monthly cadence — at most one StatementGenerated per account_id per statement_date.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Statement records are required for regulatory inspection (CONC, CCA 1974). Retained for the account lifetime plus 6 years.
jrn008_events.retention: Account lifetime + 6 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111)

jrn008_events.name: PersistentDebtAlertTriggered
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-003 detects at statement generation (PH-028) that ENT-023.persistent_debt_months has crossed an FCA CONC 6.7.27 intervention threshold (18, 27, or 36 months). Published after EVT-047 StatementGenerated is published for the same cycle.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-003). Consumed by SVC-053 (regulatory communication), SVC-103 (audit), and compliance monitoring. Intra-capability. Note: if a cross-capability risk review is required (e.g. CAP-004 SVC-012 for updated credit scoring at 27-month intervention), SVC-003 would publish a separate CreditCheckRequested event.

payload_schema.persistent_debt_months: integer — current value (18, 27, or 36 at trigger points)
payload_schema.closing_balance: number — current outstanding balance in GBP
payload_schema.interest_and_fees_ytd: number — total interest and fees charged in the persistent debt window
payload_schema.principal_repaid_ytd: number — total principal repaid in the persistent debt window

jrn008_events.regulatory_note: FCA CONC 6.7.27–6.7.40 (PS20/8): At 18 months (first_contact), bank must contact customer explaining they are in persistent debt and encourage higher repayments. At 27 months (second_contact), bank must offer a repayment plan. At 36 months (limit_suspension_warning), bank must suspend credit limit increases and may suspend the credit facility if no resolution. The communication content is FCA-prescribed — handled by SVC-053 using pre-approved communication templates.

consumers.action: Dispatches FCA-mandated persistent debt communication to customer. Communication content is prescribed by FCA CONC 6.7.27–6.7.40 PS20/8. Content varies by intervention_level: first_contact (encouragement to repay more), second_contact (repayment plan offer), limit_suspension_warning (credit limit suspension notice). Must be sent via durable medium (email + secure message; letter if paper preference). SLA: within 5 business days of trigger.
Records persistent debt alert in WORM audit trail. FCA supervision: bank must evidence that persistent debt communications were sent on time at the correct thresholds.

At intervention_level = limit_suspension_warning (36 months): triggers automatic credit limit suspension on ENT-023 (status change to 'suspended' if no repayment arrangement confirmed within 30 days). Idempotent on account_id + intervention_level.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key. At most one PersistentDebtAlertTriggered per account per intervention_level (deduplication key: account_id + intervention_level).
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: FCA CONC 6.7 compliance evidence. FCA may require evidence that the bank identified persistent debt customers and sent communications at the prescribed thresholds. Retained for account lifetime plus 6 years.
jrn008_events.retention: Account lifetime + 6 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111)

jrn008_events.name: InternationalTransferInitiated
jrn008_events.trigger: PER-002 (Corporate Client) submits a valid international wire transfer instruction in PH-029. SCA is completed. SVC-010 creates ENT-026 (InternationalTransfer, status = pending_compliance) and publishes this event. Carries all beneficiary details, amount, currency, purpose code, and charges type required for concurrent compliance checks.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-010); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-051 — sanctions screening), CAP-004 (SVC-013 — fraud scoring), and SVC-103 (audit). Crosses CAP-003 → CAP-005 and CAP-003 → CAP-004 boundaries.

payload_schema.beneficiary_name: string — beneficiary legal name (FATF travel rule)
payload_schema.amount: number (decimal, 2 dp) — transfer amount in transfer currency

consumers.action: Triggers concurrent sanctions screening of beneficiary (name, IBAN, BIC) and all correspondent chain BICs against OFSI, UN, EU, and OFAC lists. Publishes TransferSanctionsScreened (EVT-051).
Triggers corporate wire fraud ML scoring. Publishes TransferFraudScored (EVT-052).
Creates immutable audit log entry. FATF travel rule originator data logged at initiation.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Contains beneficiary name and IBAN (PII/financial). FATF travel rule (UK FTR 2017) and MLR 2017 Regulation 40 require immutable originator/beneficiary records. Retained 7 years.
jrn008_events.retention: 7 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111; FATF travel rule; MLR 2017 Regulation 40)

jrn008_events.name: FXQuoteProvided
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-010 obtains an FX rate from the internal FX pricing engine in PH-030 for a cross-currency international transfer. Published when a new FXQuotation (ENT-027) is created, including on quote refresh after lapse. Not published for GBP-denominated transfers.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and consumed within CAP-003 (International Payments). Also consumed by CAP-007 (SVC-017 Digital Channels) for UI rendering — this consumption crosses the CAP-003 → CAP-007 boundary.

payload_schema.sell_currency: string (ISO 4217) — always GBP for UK corporate transfers
payload_schema.rate: number (decimal, 6 dp) — all-in FX rate inclusive of margin
payload_schema.quoted_gbp_equivalent: number (decimal, 2 dp) — GBP cost at this rate

consumers.action: Renders FX rate, GBP equivalent, and acceptance countdown timer in the corporate portal. Prompts PER-002 to accept or decline.
Logs FX quote details. FCA Consumer Duty fair value evidence and FX transparency audit trail.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: FX rate and GBP equivalent are financial data. Consumer Duty evidence of fair pricing. Retained 7 years.

jrn008_events.name: TransferSanctionsScreened
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-051 completes concurrent multi-entity sanctions screening after consuming InternationalTransferInitiated (EVT-049). Screens beneficiary name/IBAN/BIC and each BIC in the correspondent chain against OFSI, UN, EU, and OFAC lists. Published with a consolidated outcome after all entity screens complete. Cross-capability: published by CAP-005, consumed by CAP-003.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-051); consumed by CAP-003 (SVC-010). Crosses CAP-005 → CAP-003 boundary.

payload_schema.screening_result_id: string (UUID v4) — SVC-103 audit log entry reference
payload_schema.outcome: string enum (clear | hit | error) — consolidated across all screened entities
payload_schema.hit_entity_count: integer — number of entities with sanctions match (0 if clear)

jrn008_events.payload_omissions: Hit entity names/IBAN/BIC details not included — tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A). Details available only via SVC-103 audit log with MLRO access.

consumers.action: Evaluates outcome. If hit: sets InternationalTransfer.status = sanctions_blocked; publishes TransferFailed (EVT-057); alerts SVC-014/MLRO. If clear: waits for EVT-052 (correlation map on transfer_id).
Creates immutable OFSI-compliant sanctions decision record. Required for OFSI audit programme.
Archives sanctions outcome. OFSI 5-year retention minimum.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic compliance.sanctions.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: OFSI requires audit log of all sanctions screening decisions including cleared hits. Minimum 5 years retention.
jrn008_events.retention: 5 years minimum (OFSI obligation); 7 years where outcome = hit

jrn008_events.name: TransferFraudScored
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-013 completes corporate wire fraud scoring after consuming InternationalTransferInitiated (EVT-049). Uses a corporate wire fraud ML model (distinct from the retail FPS model). Published with risk_score, risk_level, and model_version. Cross-capability: published by CAP-004, consumed by CAP-003.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-013); consumed by CAP-003 (SVC-010). Crosses CAP-004 → CAP-003 boundary.

payload_schema.fraud_score_id: string (UUID v4) — SVC-013 internal score record
payload_schema.risk_score: number (0.0–1.0, 4 dp) — ML model fraud probability
payload_schema.top_risk_features: array<string> — top 3 contributing feature names (no values — privacy-preserving)

consumers.action: Evaluates risk_level. If block: sets InternationalTransfer.status = fraud_blocked; publishes TransferFailed (EVT-057). If non-block: waits for EVT-051 (correlation map on transfer_id).
Logs fraud score and risk level. Consumer Duty AI/ML decision audit trail and Failure to Prevent Fraud evidence.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic fraud.scores.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: AI/ML scoring decision audit trail required under Consumer Duty and Failure to Prevent Fraud (ECTA 2023). Retained 7 years.
jrn008_events.retention: 7 years (FCA Consumer Duty; Failure to Prevent Fraud corporate liability evidence)

jrn008_events.name: TransferCleared
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-010 has received both EVT-051 (outcome = clear) and EVT-052 (risk_level != block), and has assembled the SWIFT pacs.008 message with UETR in PH-032. Signals that the transfer is cleared for SWIFT submission. Analogous to PaymentCleared (EVT-182) in JRN-002.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and consumed within CAP-003 (SVC-010 internal state machine trigger). SVC-103 also consumes for audit.

payload_schema.gbp_equivalent: number (decimal, 2 dp) — final GBP debit amount

consumers.action: Triggers PH-033 SWIFT submission.
Records transfer clearance with gpi_uetr for SWIFT gpi audit trail.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: FATF travel rule: immutable record that transfer was compliance-cleared before SWIFT submission.

jrn008_events.name: SWIFTMessageSent
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-010 successfully submits the pacs.008 to the SWIFT network via SAA Cloud in PH-033. SWIFTMessage.sent_timestamp is set. Also triggers the BusinessAccount debit at SVC-005 (CAP-002) via async cross-capability consumption.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-010); consumed by CAP-002 (SVC-005) for account debit. Crosses CAP-003 → CAP-002 boundary.

payload_schema.business_account_id: string (UUID v4) — for SVC-005 debit instruction

consumers.action: Debits BusinessAccount.balance by gbp_equivalent. Idempotent on transfer_id. Cross-capability async. Publishes intra-CAP-002 BusinessAccountDebited event.
Records SWIFT submission timestamp for gpi SLA tracking.
Archives SWIFT message sent event. FATF travel rule retention.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Contains business_account_id and gbp_equivalent (financial). FATF travel rule audit evidence. Retained 7 years.
jrn008_events.retention: 7 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111; FATF travel rule)

jrn008_events.name: CorrespondentAcknowledged
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-010 receives a SWIFT gpi ACSP (AcceptedSettlementInProcess) acknowledgement from the first correspondent bank in PH-033. SWIFTMessage.ack_timestamp is set. Signals that the correspondent has accepted and is processing the pacs.008.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-010); consumed primarily within CAP-003. SVC-017 (CAP-007) also consumes for portal status update.

consumers.action: Updates corporate portal transfer tracker to 'Processing at correspondent bank'.
Records correspondent acknowledgement timestamp for SWIFT gpi SLA monitoring.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international.

jrn008_events.name: TransferCompleted
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-010 receives SWIFT gpi ACCC (AcceptedCreditSettlementCompleted) for the transfer's UETR in PH-034, confirming the beneficiary bank has credited the beneficiary's account. InternationalTransfer.status = completed.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-010); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-014 — AML transaction monitoring) and cross-cutting services. Crosses CAP-003 → CAP-005 boundary.

consumers.action: Dispatches push notification and email to PER-002 confirming transfer completion with UETR and SWIFT reference.
Updates BusinessCustomer transaction monitoring profile with completed international transfer value and destination jurisdiction (GOV-005-R01 ongoing monitoring).
Creates immutable completion record. FATF travel rule end-to-end completion evidence.
Archives completed transfer event. MLR 2017 Regulation 40 and FATF travel rule retention.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international. Terminal event — no further events published for this transfer_id after TransferCompleted.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: Contains beneficiary_name and gbp_equivalent (PII/financial). FATF travel rule and MLR 2017 Regulation 40 require immutable end-to-end records. Retained 7 years.
jrn008_events.retention: 7 years (WORM audit pipeline — SVC-111; FATF travel rule; MLR 2017)

jrn008_events.name: TransferFailed
jrn008_events.trigger: Published by SVC-010 when the international transfer fails at any stage. Failure reasons: sanctions_block (EVT-051 outcome = hit); fraud_block (EVT-052 risk_level = block); compliance_timeout; correspondent_rejection (SWIFT pacs.002 RJCT); account debit failure. Terminal failure event — InternationalTransfer.status transitions to a terminal failed state.
jrn008_events.journey_phase: PH-031 or PH-033 (depending on failure reason)
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-010); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-014 — sanctions block MLRO alert) and cross-cutting services. For sanctions_block: crosses CAP-003 → CAP-005 boundary.

payload_schema.failure_reason: string enum (sanctions_block | fraud_block | compliance_timeout | correspondent_rejection | insufficient_funds | account_debit_failure | internal_error)
payload_schema.failure_reason_code: string — ISO 20022 reason code for correspondent_rejection (e.g. AC01); null for internal failures
