payload_schema.gpi_uetr: string (UUID v4) — set if failure occurs after UETR assignment; null otherwise

jrn008_events.payload_omissions: For sanctions_block: specific matched entity name/IBAN/BIC NOT included — tipping-off prohibition (POCA 2002 s333A). Only screening_result_id included as reference to SVC-103 audit log (MLRO-only access).

consumers.action: Dispatches generic decline notification. For sanctions_block and fraud_block: no specific reason disclosed. For correspondent_rejection: standardised reason text from ISO 20022 reason code.
For failure_reason = sanctions_block: triggers MLRO alert and investigation workflow. OFSI notification assessed within 14 days (GOV-005-R02).
Creates immutable failure audit record. Required for regulatory audit and PSR dispute resolution.
Archives failure event. Sanctions blocks retained 5–7 years per GOV-005-R02.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-transfer strict ordering via transfer_id partition key on topic payments.international. Terminal event.
jrn008_events.worm_rationale: All failure types require immutable audit evidence. Sanctions blocks require OFSI audit log. Fraud blocks require Failure to Prevent Fraud evidence. Retained 7 years.
jrn008_events.retention: 7 years for all failure types; 5 years minimum for sanctions_block (OFSI requirement)

jrn008_events.name: ConsentRequested
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-017 (channel) has called POST /open-banking-consents synchronously. SVC-001 has validated the TPP credentials (ENT-031 status = active), validated the OBIE payment schema, and created an OpenBankingConsent with status = awaiting_auth. Published to the openbanking.consents topic for audit and monitoring consumers.

consumers.action: Writes to WORM audit pipeline. Immutable record of consent creation for PSR 2017 compliance audit trail.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent ordering via consent_id partition key on topic openbanking.consents.

jrn008_events.name: ConsentAuthorised
jrn008_events.trigger: The customer has completed SCA (via SVC-100) and confirmed the payment on the consent screen at PH-037. SVC-001 has atomically set ENT-030.status = authorised, ENT-030.sca_completed = true, ENT-030.authorised_at, ENT-030.customer_id, and ENT-030.account_id. Dynamic-linked SCA binds the customer's authentication to the specific amount and payee per PSD2 RTS Article 97.

payload_schema.cop_result: string (optional) — enum: match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist

consumers.action: WORM audit record. Evidence that PSD2 RTS dynamic-linked SCA was completed binding the customer to the specific payment amount and payee.
Sends push notification to customer confirming they have authorised an open banking payment consent.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent strict ordering via consent_id partition key on topic openbanking.consents. Published after EVT-058 for the same consent_id.

jrn008_events.name: ConsentRevoked
jrn008_events.trigger: Published when the customer declines the consent at PH-037 (revocation_reason = customer_declined) or revokes a previously authorised consent via the bank's consent dashboard (revocation_reason = customer_revoked_dashboard). ENT-030.status = revoked, revoked_at set. Terminal state for the consent.

payload_schema.customer_id: string (UUID v4) — may be null if customer declined before SCA identity link
payload_schema.revocation_reason: string — enum: customer_declined | customer_revoked_dashboard | tpp_requested | bank_administrative

consumers.action: WORM audit record of consent revocation. Required under PSR 2017 and UK GDPR right of withdrawal.
Notifies the customer of consent revocation (dashboard revocation scenario only).

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent ordering via consent_id partition key on topic openbanking.consents.

jrn008_events.name: OpenBankingPaymentInitiated
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-017 (channel) has called POST /payments on SVC-001 synchronously with a valid, authorised, non-expired consent_id. SVC-001 has created ENT-008 PaymentIntent (status = pending_screening, origination_channel = open_banking) and atomically set ENT-030.status = consumed. EVT-179 (PaymentIntentCreated) is also published to trigger the JRN-002 execution chain. EVT-061 is the open-banking-specific wrapper enabling OB-domain consumers to subscribe without coupling to the core payment event stream.

consumers.action: WORM audit record linking OB consent to PaymentIntent for PSR 2017 and Open Banking Ltd reporting.
Sends in-progress push notification to customer: 'Your Open Banking payment to [payee_name] for [amount] is being processed.'

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-payment-intent ordering via payment_intent_id partition key on topic openbanking.payments. Published after EVT-059 (ConsentAuthorised) for the same consent_id.

jrn008_events.name: OpenBankingPaymentCompleted
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-001 has consumed EVT-183 (PaymentExecuted from SVC-009), debited the account ledger atomically, and set PaymentIntent.status = completed. Published after EVT-184 (AccountDebited) is confirmed. SVC-017 consumes this event to update the OBIE payment status to AcceptedSettlementCompleted for TPP polling.

payload_schema.fps_reference: string — Vocalink FPS transaction reference from ENT-009

consumers.action: Updates OB payment resource status cache to AcceptedSettlementCompleted with fps_reference for TPP polling.
Sends payment success push notification to PER-001 including fps_reference.
WORM audit record including FPS reference for scheme reconciliation.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-payment-intent strict ordering via payment_intent_id partition key on topic openbanking.payments. Published after EVT-061 for the same payment_intent_id.

jrn008_events.name: OpenBankingPaymentFailed
jrn008_events.trigger: Published by SVC-001 when an open-banking-initiated PaymentIntent transitions to any terminal failure state during PH-039. Failure reasons: sanctions_blocked (EVT-185 consumed), fraud_blocked (EVT-186 consumed), fps_rejection, fps_timeout, insufficient_funds (PH-038 validation failure — in this case EVT-179 is not published and EVT-063 is the sole OB failure signal). Internal failure_reason must NOT be forwarded verbatim to the TPP — mapped to OBIE-standard error codes.

payload_schema.payment_intent_id: string (UUID v4) — may be null if failure occurred before PaymentIntent creation
payload_schema.failure_reason: string — enum: sanctions_blocked | fraud_blocked | fps_rejection | fps_timeout | insufficient_funds | daily_limit_exceeded | consent_expired | account_inactive. INTERNAL ONLY — never forwarded to TPP verbatim.
payload_schema.obie_error_code: string — OBIE-standard error code for TPP response (e.g. UK.OBIE.Rules.FailedRiskRules for fraud/sanctions)

jrn008_events.payload_omissions: For sanctions_blocked and fraud_blocked: specific reason must not be disclosed to TPP or customer (tipping-off prohibition POCA 2002 s333A; fraud evasion prevention). obie_error_code uses generic UK.OBIE.Rules.FailedRiskRules.

consumers.action: Updates OB payment resource status to Rejected. Uses obie_error_code for the TPP poll response. Must not expose failure_reason verbatim.
Sends customer-safe failure notification to PER-001. Fraud and sanctions reasons presented as 'payment could not be processed' only.
WORM audit record including internal failure_reason for PSR 2017 and APP fraud audit purposes.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-consent ordering via consent_id partition key on topic openbanking.payments.

jrn008_events.name: CardAuthorisationRequested
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-011 has received an ISO 8583 / ISO 20022 authorisation request from the card network (PER-009) in PH-041. PAN tokenised to card_number_token on ingress. CardAuthorisation entity (ENT-032) created with status = pending_decision. Published before the decision is made to ensure an immutable audit record exists even if SVC-011 crashes during decision processing.

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER raw PAN. PCI DSS Req 3.5.1.
payload_schema.transaction_type: string enum (card_present | card_not_present | contactless | atm_withdrawal | recurring)
payload_schema.three_ds_result: string enum (authenticated | attempted | not_authenticated | not_required | not_applicable)

consumers.action: Creates immutable audit log entry. PCI DSS v4.0 Req 10.2.1 — log all access to cardholder data. WORM pipeline write.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic card.authorisations.

jrn008_events.name: CardAuthorisationCompleted
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-011 has made an approved authorisation decision (PH-042). CardAuthorisation.status = approved. Authorisation response sent to card network. Published after response transmission.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-011); consumed by CAP-004 (SVC-013 fraud pattern learning) and CAP-001 (SVC-001 debit balance reservation; SVC-003 credit balance reservation).

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER raw PAN.
payload_schema.billing_amount_gbp: string (decimal as string) — GBP equivalent; equal to amount if GBP

consumers.action: Post-auth fraud pattern learning: updates velocity counters, enriches behaviour model. Publishes EVT-068 if suspicious pattern detected.
card_type = debit: decrements Account.available_balance by billing_amount_gbp. Balance reservation on auth_id. Idempotent. P99 < 2 seconds.
card_type = credit: decrements CreditCardAccount.available_balance by billing_amount_gbp. Balance reservation on auth_id. Idempotent. P99 < 2 seconds.
WORM audit record. PCI DSS Req 10.2.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic card.authorisations.

jrn008_events.name: CardAuthorisationDeclined
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-011 has made a declined authorisation decision (PH-042). CardAuthorisation.status = declined. Decline response sent to card network. Published after response transmission. Internal decline_reason is deliberately EXCLUDED from the payload to prevent card testing attacks.

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER raw PAN.
payload_schema.scheme_response_code: string — ISO 8583 decline code (e.g. '51'). External-facing only. Internal decline_reason excluded.

jrn008_events.payload_omissions: decline_reason (internal enum) intentionally excluded. Prevents card testing attacks. decline_reason is logged in WORM audit via SVC-103 direct ENT-032 access — not via this payload.

consumers.action: Updates decline rate counters for card_number_token. High decline rates on CNP transactions signal card testing. May publish EVT-068.
WORM audit record.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic card.authorisations.

jrn008_events.name: CardSettlementProcessed
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-011 has processed the end-of-day clearing file (PH-045), matched a clearing item to ENT-032 by auth_id, and created a CardSettlement entity (ENT-033).
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-011); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001 debit final ledger posting; SVC-003 credit final ledger posting). Triggers release of balance reservation and posting of settled amount to account ledger.

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER raw PAN.
payload_schema.settlement_amount: string (decimal as string) — final settled amount GBP

consumers.action: card_type = debit: posts final debit of settlement_amount to Account ledger. Releases balance reservation from EVT-065. Idempotent on settlement_id.
card_type = credit: posts final debit to CreditCardAccount statement balance. Releases balance reservation from EVT-065. Idempotent on settlement_id.
WORM audit record. Records interchange_fee for PSR interchange cap compliance.

jrn008_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-card strict ordering via card_number_token partition key on topic card.settlements.

jrn008_events.name: SuspiciousCardActivityDetected
jrn008_events.source_entity_name: Stateless — published by SVC-013 post-auth fraud pattern analysis engine
jrn008_events.trigger: SVC-013 has consumed EVT-065 (CardAuthorisationCompleted) or EVT-066 (CardAuthorisationDeclined) and detected a suspicious cross-transaction pattern: geographic impossibility, high velocity, card testing pattern, or amount anomaly.
jrn008_events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-013); consumed by CAP-003 (SVC-011 card block), SVC-053 (customer notification), SVC-103 (audit).

payload_schema.card_number_token: string — format-preserving token. NEVER raw PAN.
payload_schema.pattern_type: string enum (geographic_impossibility | high_velocity | card_testing | amount_anomaly | mcc_anomaly | cumulative_fraud_signal)
payload_schema.risk_score: decimal (0.0–1.0) — ACCESS CONTROLLED. Shared only with SVC-011 and PER-054. SVC-103 receives redacted version without raw score.

consumers.action: Queue AML cash threshold report for MLRO review; assess for suspicious activity patterns.
Write immutable AML threshold breach record.

jrn25_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.transactions.
jrn25_events.worm_rationale: AML cash threshold report is an MLR 2017 regulatory record — immutable for FCA audit.

jrn30_events.name: InsurancePolicyBound
jrn30_events.trigger: Customer accepts insurance terms and IPID. Policy successfully bound with underwriter (Aviva). InsurancePolicy created with status = active.

consumers.action: Intra-capability: upgrade current account to Premier with insurance bundle fee.
Update customer app to display active insurance policy and management options.
Send policy confirmation email with certificate of insurance.
Write immutable insurance distribution record (FCA PROD / ICOBS evidence).

jrn30_events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer ordering via customer_id partition key on topic retail.insurance.
jrn30_events.worm_rationale: Insurance distribution with Consumer Duty evidence is an FCA PROD record — immutable for regulatory audit.

jrn18_events.name: MerchantApplicationSubmitted
jrn18_events.ordering_guarantees: First event in the journey. Triggers KYC in CAP-005.

jrn18_events.name: MerchantKYCCompleted
jrn18_events.trigger: KYC/AML screening on merchant, directors, and UBOs completes
jrn18_events.ordering_guarantees: Published after MerchantApplicationSubmitted. Cross-capability: CAP-005 -> CAP-002.

jrn18_events.name: MerchantCreditAssessmentCompleted
jrn18_events.trigger: Credit risk and chargeback assessment completes

jrn18_events.name: MerchantApproved
jrn18_events.trigger: Merchant application approved by bank staff
jrn18_events.ordering_guarantees: Published after all assessments pass. Triggers scheme registration in CAP-003.

jrn18_events.name: MerchantTerminalProvisioned
jrn18_events.trigger: Payment terminal or gateway provisioned for the merchant

jrn18_events.name: MerchantSchemeRegistered
jrn18_events.trigger: Merchant registered with Visa and/or Mastercard — MIDs assigned
jrn18_events.ordering_guarantees: Published after MerchantApproved consumed by CAP-003. Cross-capability: CAP-003 -> CAP-002.

jrn18_events.name: MerchantLive
jrn18_events.trigger: Test transaction passed — merchant is live and can process real payments
jrn18_events.ordering_guarantees: Final event in the journey. Published after MerchantTerminalProvisioned and test transaction success.
